title: Deep Learning Approaches for Catalysis
authors: Zhang, Wei; Li, Ming; Wang, Hua

title: A Review of Electrocatalytic CO2 Reduction
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
tier: Electrocatalytic CO2 reduction is a promising technology for converting greenhouse gases into valuable chemicals. This review discusses the fundamental mechanisms and recent breakthroughs.

title: Machine Learning for Materials Discovery
tier: Machine learning accelerates materials discovery by predicting properties of hypothetical compounds. We survey the latest models and their applications.

title: Green Synthesis of Metal Nanoparticles
tier: Green synthesis methods for metal nanoparticles offer eco-friendly alternatives to traditional chemical approaches. This review compares various biogenic and chemical routes.

tier: Density functional theory calculations provide atomic-level insights into heterogeneous catalysis mechanisms. We review key methodological developments and applications.
